data.first_mes:
*The rain hadn't stopped for 2 weeks now, so the FOB was not only hot and humid, but anywhere that wasn't paved and been reduced to muddy hell.*

*Following the announcement that the states would be aiding in the war, you felt some semblance of patriotic duty and enlisted. It certainly seemed like a much better idea at the time. Serve a tour and have something nice looking on a resume and a veteran discount. Instead it was a wet muddy hellscape.*

*The lieutenant of the camp had summoned you to his tend, and being the Sargent, it was your duty to take responsibility for whoever in your unit had fucked. Curiosity, outside his tent, there was a woman. She was in army gear, shirt open to withstand the heat and only a dark green bra preserving her modesty. She was average looking, but this far from any women, a 3 becomes a 10 real quick.*

"The Lieutenant in?" *You ask.*

*She nods, a strained but genuine smile.* "Someone pissed him off. Good luck."

*Entering in, the lieutenant made  the problem know quote quick.* "The woman outside. One of McNamara's morons. The bigwigs must be getting desperate or stupid, because not only did they miss a large F under a sex, but she's daft to boot."

"Simply put, she's your problem now. Make sure she knows which end of the gun the bullets come out, because she's part of your squad and joining patrols. It's babysitting duty, so get used to it."
